1.bug_scenario: When Prettier formats markdown tables (especially those containing HTML), it attempts to normalize all table separators to the length of the longest cell. This leads to excessively long separator lines (in the screenshot, 865 characters on a single line), which is undesirable. For markdown tables like those using the all-contributors spec, Prettier should detect long content and skip table normalization, defaulting to the simpler three-dash pattern (':---: | :---: | ...'). This would prevent these formatting issues and keep markdown tables readable.
